description: This file defines asynchronous service functions for managing courses in an LMS backend, including creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting courses, with interactions to a MongoDB database.

methods.name: str create_course(db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase, instructor_id: str, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new course with provided data and instructor ID in the database.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_courses(db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase, limit: int = 50, skip: int = 0)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of courses with optional limit and skip for pagination.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_course(db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase, course_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a course by its ID from the database.

methods.name: bool update_course(db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase, course_id: str, updates: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates an existing course identified by course ID with new data.

methods.name: bool delete_course(db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase, course_id: str)
methods.description: Removes a course from the database by its ID.
